terminals.name: csp-backend
terminals.command: cd services/csp && source ../../.venv/bin/activate && ANILA_ALLOW_DEV_SECRET=1 ANILA_ENV=development ANILA_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=development ALLOW_AUTO_KEYGEN=true COOKIE_SECURE=false DATABASE_URL=postgresql://csp:csp_password@localhost:5432/csp uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
